authorization.authority: user explicit full R1 execution packet

prior_eval_reconstruction_authority.use: hash values are read from the bound generator-receipt object already present in lineage; R1 verifies the object hash only and never parses its episode-id arrays

old_training_corpus.reader: R1 replays the bound Rust generator directly; sidecar code accesses only the actual Episode identity/render fields and the actual selector request. Any parsing of existing JSONL scope rows is streaming and field-selective; gold_targets and unknown fields are ignored, never materialized into R1 sidecar structures. The v09 parser caveat remains attached to v09; v09-derived rows/mappings and files are not inputs or accessed.

prior_panel_identity.source_policy: Do not open E1 panel body, candidate join, candidate features, targets, predictions, or metrics. Reconstruct the prior 2,000-neighborhood / 22,000-episode identity inventory by rerunning the exact bound v08N generator source at seed 20260922 for the sealed eval family/sequence partition; emit only R1 identity-schema sidecar rows and never persist generated targets or model inputs.
prior_panel_identity.reconstruction_acceptance: The 2,000 hashed generated prior neighborhood identities must byte-match the sealed v05 set exactly before using the reconstructed five-field prior-panel identity inventory. If not, stop before panel generation.

r1_panel.candidate_sequence_order: ascending sequence 0..531; accept first 500 passing the frozen identity collision predicate; at most 32 rejected candidates per family; exhaustion is terminal with no replacement stream
r1_panel.semantic_contract: original P fresh-panel contract unchanged except R1 namespace/seed; same exact-world validation and p0-p3 surfaces
r1_panel.E1_identity_denylist: SHA256(canonical neighborhood_id) membership only; no text/semantic similarity rule
r1_panel.five_field_overlap: independent set intersections for world_id, root_id, episode_id, full_rendered_input_hash, selector_input_hash against selected 55,000 training occurrences and the reconstructed 22,000-episode prior panel; zero required in every dimension
r1_panel.matching: for each anchor choose argmin_j abs(||h_Nj-h_A||2 - ||h_S-h_A||2), j in neutral_1..neutral_8; deterministic tie-break SHA256(anchor_id + '|' + neutral_role), ascending lexical digest; no direction/cosine or outcomes

feature_and_model.state_feature: final-layer mean_full@16, exact-length, single-row, no padding, max_length 1024, BF16 backbone, FP32 output, dimension 2048
feature_and_model.candidate_feature: name_definition surface, mean_full@16, exact-length, single-row, no padding, batch size 1, BF16 backbone, FP32 output, 48 training candidates + 16 fresh held-out candidates
feature_and_model.feature_cache_composition: 22,000 fresh-panel role episodes plus 16 fresh candidate semantic features; exact row identities and input hashes are sealed

training.paired_initialization: one shared byte-identical head initialization per seed across three arms; old v0.8N heads are never initializations
training.head: CompatibilityHead(2048, mlp, 128), 590081 trainable parameters, raw float32 state/candidate inputs
training.recipe: frozen original P run contract: AdamW lr .002 wd .01 betas .9/.999 eps 1e-8; CE + .25 multiclass Brier; batch capacity 256; 40 steps/epoch; 3 epochs/120 steps; no scheduler, clipping, autocast, TF32 matmul, or gradient accumulation
training.occurrences: sealed original common primary stream and arm head-input manifests; 10,000 primary + 5,000 auxiliary events per epoch
training.resume: only from last fully validated step checkpoint with optimizer and RNG; failed partial outputs preserved; no seed replacement

evaluation_and_analysis.opening: one fresh R1 panel opening, only after all nine runs, 378 checkpoints, three init templates, and telemetry hash tree are sealed
evaluation_and_analysis.prediction_matrix: 381 cells x 8,000 rows = 3,048,000 raw prediction rows, all emitted before metrics are opened
evaluation_and_analysis.metrics: unchanged original P analysis contract; per-seed, arm, global step, family, full transition decomposition; step 80 baseline; simultaneous neighborhood-cluster bands and onset rules unchanged
evaluation_and_analysis.fresh_world_scope: new worlds/neighborhoods within four fixed held-out families and p0-p3 templates; not novel-template or novel-family generalization
evaluation_and_analysis.intermediate_checkpoint: descriptive trajectory only; no promotion, model recommendation, stopping decision, or operating-point claim

pre_run_provenance_note.incident: During R1 pre-contract reconnaissance, an original v08N generator-receipt JSON object was converted for inspection and its identity-only train/eval episode ID arrays appeared in tool output. No targets, features, predictions, metrics, or E1 content were present in that object. Those arrays are not used as R1 inputs; R1 reconstructs identities from bound generator source. The access is disclosed and is not represented as a narrower read.
pre_run_provenance_note.v09_caveat: The disclosed v09 parser caveat remains attached only to v09; no v09-derived rows or mappings are inputs to R1.
